_comment: The event deck. One is drawn for a club every few matches, and one league-wide when the
commissioner closes a round. An event is a PROBLEM THE MANAGER ANSWERS — it blocks further
match reports until it is dealt with — so every template here must earn that interruption.
Add your own freely. Nothing is referenced by name in code except `kind`, which must be one
of the vocabulary in lib/services/effects.ts, and `target`/`type` macros beginning with @.
RULES THE VALIDATION TEST ENFORCES (lib/services/events.test.ts):
- Every template has at least one option with no `cost` and no `requires`. Reporting is
blocked while an event is pending, so a club must always have something it can click.
- Exactly one option is marked `default: true` — what a delegation or a commissioner
force-resolve falls back to.
- Three options only when `tierLadder: true`. Otherwise one branch is always dominated
and the choice is fake; two options trading one resource against another is the shape
that works.
- Every lasting effect carries `label` and `liftedMessage`. A restriction that expires
silently is one the manager never noticed they had.
- Every percentage-of-cash cost carries a `min`. Without a floor a broke club pays 12% of
nothing, and the event only bites the people who could afford it anyway.
LETTING THE CLUB CHOOSE WHO: an option with `repeat: "@starters"` becomes one option per
Pokémon — 'Let Garchomp go', 'Let Ferrothorn go' — each fully resolved, spread across the
squad by value. A decision is still just a key, so delegation and force-resolve keep
working. The default option may not repeat: it has to exist for every club.
MONEY THAT SCALES: a win is worth P1,000 in the beginner tier and P100,000 in Champion, so
`amountWins` / `rewardWins` / `penaltyWins` price a sum in the club's own win rewards, and
`pct` + `min` prices it against the balance. Flat `amount` only where neither makes sense.
PLACEHOLDERS: {pokemon} {team} {cost} {matches} {type}
{incoming} — who arrives in a swap or a release-for-two
{amount} {reward} {penalty} {back} — sums the effect settled at draw time
TARGET MACROS: @mostValuableStarter @cheapestStarter @randomStarter @captain @trigger
TYPE MACROS:   @mostOwnedType @randomOwnedType

events.title: Forgotten man
events.description: {pokemon} has not seen the field in a long time. It has noticed, and so has everyone else in the dressing room.

options.label: Put it straight back in
options.detail: It starts your next 4 matches, whatever else happens.

effects.label: {pokemon} must start
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has had its run in the side. You can rotate again.

options.label: Leave it where it is
options.detail: Nothing changes, except what it thinks it's worth. Value down 15%.

events.title: Running on empty
events.description: {pokemon} has started all ten of your last ten. The results are holding up; the Pokémon isn't.

virtue.title: Some of them are built for it
virtue.description: Ten from ten, and {pokemon} came in on its day off. The rest of {team} has noticed who sets the standard.

effects.label: {pokemon} setting the standard — win rewards up 40%
effects.liftedMessage: The lift {pokemon} gave everybody has levelled off. Rewards are back to normal.

options.label: Rest it properly
options.detail: Out for 3 matches. It comes back sharp.

effects.label: {pokemon} — rested
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is rested and available again.

options.label: Push on regardless
options.detail: It keeps playing. Every value move it makes is halved for 5 matches.

effects.label: Squad fatigue — value moves halved
effects.liftedMessage: The squad has its legs back. Values move normally again.

events.title: Too many new faces
events.description: {team} has been busy in the market, and it shows. Nobody quite knows where anybody else is going to be.

options.label: Book a training camp
options.detail: {cost}, and they sort themselves out.

options.label: Let them work it out on the field
options.detail: No switching for 3 matches while they learn each other.

effects.label: No switching — the squad is still settling
effects.liftedMessage: The squad has settled. Switch freely again.

events.title: Nothing to lose
events.description: Bottom of the table has its privileges. A backer nobody else would take a call from wants to bankroll {team}.

options.label: Take the cash
options.detail: ₽40,000, no strings.

options.label: Put it into the squad
options.detail: They fund a specialist coach for {pokemon}. Value up 30%.

events.title: Transfer request
events.description: {pokemon} has asked to leave. Three defeats in a row, and the mood around {team} has turned.

virtue.title: It has decided to carry this team
virtue.description: {pokemon} was asked how it felt about the run of results. It answered by dragging {team} through training like a side that has forgotten how to lose.

effects.label: {pokemon} is inspired — value moves amplified
effects.liftedMessage: The purple patch is over. {pokemon} moves in value normally again.

options.label: Pay a loyalty bonus
options.detail: {cost}. It stays, and the show of faith is worth something — value up 5%.

options.label: Send your captain to talk it down
options.detail: Settles it outright. Your captain can't step into another dispute for 5 matches.

effects.label: Your captain has spent its credit in the dressing room
effects.liftedMessage: Your captain has the dressing room's ear again.

options.label: Refuse it
options.detail: It stays, and it sulks. Five matches with no EVs and no Mega Evolution.

effects.label: {pokemon} — run it with no EVs invested
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has come round. Train it properly again.

effects.label: {pokemon} — no Mega Evolution
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is ready to Mega Evolve again.

events.title: Contract standoff
events.description: {pokemon} knows exactly what it is worth to {team}, and has come to discuss the matter.

options.label: Meet the demand
options.detail: {cost}, and the matter is closed.

options.label: Promise it the shirt instead
options.detail: No money changes hands, but it starts your next 4 matches.

effects.label: {pokemon} must start — you promised
effects.liftedMessage: You kept your word to {pokemon}. Rotate as you like.

options.label: Let it run down
options.detail: Nothing now. Word gets out, and its value falls 20%.

events.title: Lost confidence
events.description: {pokemon} has stopped trying things. It is going through the motions, and the run of results is the reason.

virtue.title: Something clicked
virtue.description: Whatever was said to {pokemon} this week worked. It has been the best thing about {team} in training.

effects.label: {pokemon} is flying — value moves amplified
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is back to its usual self.

options.label: Take it out of the firing line
options.detail: Out for 2 matches while it gets its head straight.

effects.label: {pokemon} — out of the side
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is ready to play again.

options.label: Strip it back to basics
options.detail: It keeps playing, but attacks only — no status moves for 4 matches.

effects.label: {pokemon} — no status moves
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has its confidence back. Use its full moveset again.

events.title: The pitch is being relaid
events.description: {team}'s ground is a building site. The field itself is usable; nothing that changes the conditions on it is.

options.label: Rent a proper venue
options.detail: {cost}, and you play in full working conditions throughout.

options.label: Play through it
options.detail: No weather and no terrain for 5 matches.

effects.label: No weather — the pitch is being relaid
effects.liftedMessage: The new pitch is down. Set weather freely again.

effects.label: No terrain — the pitch is being relaid
effects.liftedMessage: The new pitch is down. Set terrain freely again.

events.title: Power cut at the training centre
events.description: The Key Stone rigs at {team}'s facility have been dark for three days and the contractor is not returning calls.

options.label: Hire a generator
options.detail: {cost}, and everything works as normal.

options.label: Manage without
options.detail: No Mega Evolution at all for 4 matches.

effects.label: No Mega Evolution — the Key Stone rigs are down
effects.liftedMessage: The power is back. Mega Evolution is available again.

events.title: The coach has a philosophy
events.description: {team}'s new battle coach has strong views about type synergy, and has been explaining them at length.

options.label: Humour them
options.detail: Attack only with same-type moves for 3 matches.

effects.label: Attack only with STAB moves — coach's orders
effects.liftedMessage: The coach has moved on to a new theory. Attack however you like.

options.label: Pay them off
options.detail: {cost}, and they take their philosophy elsewhere.

events.title: They have your patterns
events.description: Somebody has been charting {team}'s switches. Opponents are arriving knowing exactly what comes in and when.

options.label: Move training ground
options.detail: {cost}, and the leak stops.

options.label: Commit to what you bring
options.detail: No switching for 3 matches — if it's on the field, it stays there.

effects.label: No switching — your rotations are being read
effects.liftedMessage: You have shaken the scout. Switch freely again.

events.title: Item recall
events.description: A batch of held items has been recalled league-wide, and {team}'s order was in it.

options.label: Replace them out of pocket
options.detail: {cost}, and nobody notices.

options.label: Go without
options.detail: {pokemon} holds nothing for 4 matches.

effects.label: {pokemon} — no held item
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon}'s replacement item has arrived.

events.title: Knock in training
events.description: {pokemon} came out of a training battle holding a leg. The physio wants a decision today.

virtue.title: Nothing in it
virtue.description: {pokemon} walked into the scan laughing and walked out the same way. Whatever it was, it has gone, and it has spent the week training like something with a point to prove.

options.label: Pay for proper treatment
options.detail: {cost}. Out for 1 match and no lasting effect.

effects.label: {pokemon} — injured
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has been passed fit.

options.label: Rest it and let it heal
options.detail: Out for 3 matches. No cost, no complications.

effects.label: {pokemon} — injured
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has recovered and is available again.

options.label: Rush it back
options.detail: Available immediately, but it is nowhere near right — its value moves at half rate for 4 matches.

effects.label: Carrying an injury — value moves halved
effects.liftedMessage: The knock has finally cleared. Values move normally again.

events.title: One of them has to sit out
events.description: A league medical audit has flagged {team}'s workload. Somebody is being stood down for two matches; the only question is who picks.

options.label: Pay the appeal fee and choose yourself
options.detail: {cost}. Your cheapest starter sits out instead.

effects.label: {pokemon} — stood down
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has been cleared to play again.

options.label: Let the audit decide
options.detail: Free. {pokemon} sits out the next 2 matches.

effects.label: {pokemon} — stood down by the audit
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has been cleared to play again.

events.title: Conduct charge
events.description: The league has charged {pokemon} over an incident at the end of a recent match. {team} may make representations.

virtue.title: Charge dismissed
virtue.description: The panel watched the footage twice and threw it out inside ten minutes. {pokemon} has come back from it with a reputation for being hard done by, which is worth something.

options.label: Accept the fine
options.detail: {cost}, and the charge is dropped.

options.label: Take the ban
options.detail: {pokemon} is suspended for 3 matches.

effects.label: {pokemon} — suspended
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has served its suspension.

events.title: Regulation shift
events.description: The season's regulation update has landed hard on {type}-types, and {team} has more of them than most.

options.label: Pay the compliance levy
options.detail: {cost}, and your squad is exempt.

options.label: Field nobody affected
options.detail: No {type}-types for 3 matches.

effects.label: No {type}-types — regulation shift
effects.liftedMessage: The {type}-type restriction has been lifted.

options.label: Take the market hit instead
options.detail: Keep playing them. Every {type}-type you own loses 15% of its value.

events.title: The league wants a word about your accounts
events.description: {team}'s filings have been selected for review. The number at the bottom is not in dispute; only when it is paid.

options.label: Settle it now
options.detail: {cost}, paid today, and it is finished.

options.label: Take the payment plan
options.detail: Nothing today. ₽6,000 a match for the next 4 matches, whatever else is going on.

effects.label: Payment plan — ₽6,000 a match
effects.liftedMessage: The last instalment is paid. Your accounts are clear.

events.title: Your sponsor is pulling out
events.description: {team}'s shirt sponsor has invoked a clause nobody read closely enough at the time.

options.label: Buy out the clause
options.detail: {cost}, and the deal runs to term.

options.label: Sign with their rival instead
options.detail: Full money, but they want their mascot on the field — {pokemon} starts your next 6 matches.

effects.label: {pokemon} must start — the new sponsor insists
effects.liftedMessage: The sponsor's campaign is over. {pokemon} can be rotated again.

options.label: Play unsponsored
options.detail: Nothing to pay, but match winnings drop to 60% for 6 matches.

effects.label: Unsponsored — match winnings at 60%
effects.liftedMessage: {team} has found a new sponsor. Winnings are back to full.

events.title: Every lineup in the league has leaked
events.description: A database of registered lineups has found its way onto the forums. Everybody now knows what everybody leads with.

options.label: Pay to have your entry pulled
options.detail: {cost}, and your lineup stays private.

options.label: Lead with your captain and dare them
options.detail: {pokemon} leads every match for the next 2.

effects.label: {pokemon} must lead — your lineup is public
effects.liftedMessage: The leak has gone stale. Lead with whoever you like.

events.title: A prospect worth backing
events.description: {team}'s scouts think {pokemon} is being wasted, and have costed out what it would take to do something about it.

options.label: Back the programme
options.detail: {cost} now. {pokemon} gains 30% in value.

options.label: Pass on it
options.detail: The scouts are disappointed. Nothing else happens.

events.title: The new regimen has not agreed with everyone
events.description: {team}'s revised conditioning programme has left {pokemon} worse off than when it started.

options.label: Pull it out of the programme
options.detail: {pokemon} misses the next 2 matches. Everyone else carries on.

effects.label: {pokemon} — reacting badly to training
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has recovered from the training reaction.

options.label: Scrap the programme entirely
options.detail: Nobody misses a match, but the whole squad is off the pace — value moves at 80% for 3 matches.

effects.label: Training disrupted — value moves reduced
effects.liftedMessage: Training is back on track. Values move normally again.

events.title: A straight swap
events.description: {pokemon} has made it plain it wants a move, and a club has come forward with somebody of the same standing. No money either way — just the two of them.

options.label: Take the swap
options.detail: {pokemon} goes, {incoming} arrives. Nothing changes hands but the two of them.

options.label: Keep {pokemon}
options.detail: It stays, and it knows it was told no. Five matches with its training undone — run it with nothing invested.

effects.label: {pokemon} — run with no EVs
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has put the move behind it. Its EV spread is its own again.

events.title: Two for one
events.description: The recruitment staff at {team} have a standing proposal. Give up one of the senior squad and they will bring in two from the free market with what it frees up — quality traded for depth, and they will let you choose who pays for it.

options.label: Let {pokemon} go
options.detail: {pokemon} leaves for nothing. {incoming} arrive in its place, on free transfers.

options.label: Keep the squad together
options.detail: The recruitment staff are overruled, and take it personally. No signings, sales or trades for a round.

effects.label: Recruitment frozen — no signings, sales or trades
effects.liftedMessage: The recruitment staff have got over it. {team} can deal again.

events.title: Name your target
events.description: The sponsor at {team} wants a headline with its name on it, and has left the size of the headline entirely to you. Set a target for the next five matches. Hit it and they pay. Miss it and they take the difference out of the fee.

options.label: Two wins in five
options.detail: {reward} if you manage it. {penalty} if you don't.

effects.label: Sponsor target — 2 wins from 5
effects.liftedMessage: The sponsor's books are closed on this one.

options.label: Four wins in five
options.detail: {reward} if you manage it. {penalty} if you don't.

effects.label: Sponsor target — 4 wins from 5
effects.liftedMessage: The sponsor's books are closed on this one.

options.label: All five
options.detail: {reward} if you manage it. {penalty} if you don't. They think you won't.

effects.label: Sponsor target — 5 wins from 5
effects.liftedMessage: The sponsor's books are closed on this one.

options.label: Turn the sponsor down
options.detail: No target and no fee. They put their name on somebody else's shirt, and {team} plays six matches on reduced rewards.

effects.label: Unsponsored — win rewards at 70%
effects.liftedMessage: {team} has found a new sponsor. Win rewards are whole again.

events.title: Fee or bonus
events.description: The sponsor has come back with a simpler question. Would {team} rather be paid for turning up, or for winning?

options.label: Take the money up front
options.detail: {amount} in the bank today. Win rewards halve for the next six matches.

effects.label: Appearance fee taken — win rewards halved
effects.liftedMessage: The appearance deal has run its course. {team}'s win rewards are whole again.

options.label: Back yourselves
options.detail: Nothing today. Win rewards double for the next six matches.

effects.label: Win bonus — win rewards doubled
effects.liftedMessage: The win bonus is over. {team}'s rewards are back to normal.

events.title: The league bond
events.description: The league is raising money against next season's fixtures, and every club has been sent the same terms on the same morning.

options.label: Buy in
options.detail: {amount} locked away now. {back} back when the round after next closes.

effects.label: League bond — {amount} locked away
effects.liftedMessage: The league bond has matured. {team} has been paid out.

options.label: Stay out of it
options.detail: The league notices who didn't. Win rewards at 80% for four matches.

effects.label: Out of the bond — win rewards at 80%
effects.liftedMessage: The league has forgotten all about the bond. {team}'s rewards are whole again.

events.title: They have read the book on you
events.description: Half the league has mapped out how {team} attacks. Everybody knows which attack is coming, and they have started switching into it on purpose.

options.label: Rebuild the sets
options.detail: {cost} on analysts and practice time. The problem goes away before it costs you anything.

options.label: Beat them off-script
options.detail: Three matches without a single same-type attack. Coverage moves only.

effects.label: No same-type attacking moves
effects.liftedMessage: {team} has fresh sets ready. Same-type attacks are back on the menu.
